name: Builtin Cluster: MA Variants & Bollinger Derivatives
description: Tests: ma(type=dema/hma/kama/tema/trima/wilders/wma/zlema), vidya, bband_percent, bband_width, natr. Moving average algorithm variants and band metrics.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BUILTIN CLUSTER: MA Variants & Bollinger Derivatives
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
high = src.h
low = src.l
close = src.c

# === MOVING AVERAGE VARIANTS (8 types via ma()) ===
ma_dema = ma(type=MAType.dema, period=20)(close)
ma_hma = ma(type=MAType.hma, period=20)(close)
ma_kama = ma(type=MAType.kama, period=20)(close)
ma_tema = ma(type=MAType.tema, period=20)(close)
ma_trima = ma(type=MAType.trima, period=20)(close)
ma_wilders = ma(type=MAType.wilders, period=20)(close)
ma_wma = ma(type=MAType.wma, period=20)(close)
ma_zlema = ma(type=MAType.zlema, period=20)(close)

# === VIDYA (standalone transform, 3 options) ===
ma_vidya = vidya(short_period=2, long_period=20, alpha=0.2)(close)

# === BOLLINGER DERIVATIVES (need bbands output as input) ===
bb = bbands(close)
bb_lower = bb.bbands_lower
bb_middle = bb.bbands_middle
bb_upper = bb.bbands_upper
bpct = bband_percent()(close, bb_lower, bb_upper)
bw = bband_width()(bb_lower, bb_middle, bb_upper)

# === NORMALIZED ATR ===
natr_val = natr(high, low, close, 14)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='MA Variants (period=20): DEMA, HMA, KAMA',
    category='Moving Averages',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='DEMA', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='HMA', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='KAMA', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(close, ma_dema, ma_hma, ma_kama))

xy_lines(
    title='MA Variants: TEMA, TRIMA, VIDYA',
    category='Moving Averages',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='TEMA', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='TRIMA', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VIDYA', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(close, ma_tema, ma_trima, ma_vidya))

xy_lines(
    title='MA Variants: Wilders, WMA, ZLEMA',
    category='Moving Averages',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Wilders', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='WMA', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ZLEMA', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(close, ma_wilders, ma_wma, ma_zlema))

xy_lines(
    title='BBand %B & Width',
    category='Bollinger',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='%B', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Width', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(bpct, bw))

xy_lines(
    title='Normalized ATR (14d)',
    category='Volatility',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='NATR', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=natr_val)
